G1_unambiguity.justification: The partnership counts, configuration scores, target equation, and required selection size are all defined precisely, leaving only one reasonable interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: It specifies the input bounds and format, distinct-partnership condition, required output format, acceptance of any valid selection, and the no-solution case.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The equation holds exactly when no partnership has both endpoints selected, so the rewritten condition is equivalent to selecting an independent set of exactly k users for every input.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is generally clear and idiomatic, though its artificial arithmetic reformulation and slightly awkward notation make it less natural than the original.
